final: WITH u AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS units FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(units) AS total FROM u), s AS (SELECT product_id, units, CAST(units AS REAL)/(SELECT total FROM t) AS share FROM u), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(units) AS combined_units, AVG(share) AS avg_share_above, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
